Enforcer is a bot designed to help make managing your groups easier. For updates go to https://t.me/{0}. It does this by implementing antispam, anti media, tempbans, warnings, allowing you to set responses to hashtags etc. * This bot needs to be an admin of the group chat to function properly. * This bot functions best in supergroups. * It can be configured by sending it /menu. * This bot has many commands, to find out more information about a specific command send /help [command] EG: /help menu. To get a list of commands send /getcommands. * If you still need help click /support to join our support group.

Can be used to remove a user from a group but allows them to come back. It can be used with an id, username or by replying to the person you want kicked.
Example: /{0} while replying to a user /{0} [User ID] /{0} [Username]

Can be used to add a warning to a user, you can set the action taken on max warns and the number of warns a user can get with the menu command.
Example: /{0} while replying to a user /{0} [User ID] /{0} [Username]

Can be used to ban a user from a group (they cannot come back). If it is used by reply, you can add a reason for the ban behind /{0} which will be shown in status command
Reply to a message someone posted as a channel to ban that channel from the group instead. Telegram does not show who is behind a channel, so the channel is what gets banned.
Example: /{0} while replying to a user /{0} [Reason] while replying to a user /{0} [User ID] /{0} [Username] /{0} while replying to a message posted as a channel /{0} [Channel ID]

Can be used to unban a user from a group which will allow them back kf they were previously banned or tempbanned. It also lets a banned channel post in the group again.
Example: /{0} while replying to a user /{0} [User ID] /{0} [Username] /{0} while replying to a message posted as a channel /{0} [Channel ID]

Can be used to temporary ban a user from a group, they will only be able to come back after the time is passed. The command works by banning the user from the group and then unbanning them after the stipulated time. Usage: You need to reply to the user you want banned. Then when using the command put the number of minutes after the command is sent. If no time is stipulated the bot uses the group's default from /temptime, or one day if none is set. /tempbanlist shows who is tempbanned and for how long.
Example: /{0} 123 while replying to a user /{0} while replying to a user

Defines a welcome message for a group, that is sent whenever a new user joins or is added to the group. However, if multiple users join in a row, only one welcome message per minute will be sent in a group to avoid spam.
In the text, you can use markdown (use "/help markdown" for more infos) and the following things:
$name - Is replaced with new user's name $username - Is replaced with new user's username $id - Is replaced with new user's ID $title - Is replaced with group name
